Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE MR. RAMIL D. CASIMIRO Punong Barangay Veinte Reales Valenzuela City in•onN 65 DILG Le s. 2011 Dear Punong Barangay Casimiro: This pertains to your letter regarding DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2011-59 dated April 25, 2011 strongly discouraging Local Chief Executives and Presiding Officers of Sanggunians to conduct employees/officials' training, seminar, workshop or similar activity outside of the geographical island where the concerned local government unit is located. Per your letter, it has been the practice of your Barangay to conduct your training and seminars to different places like Zambales, Pangasinan and Baguio. Hence, you sought our legal opinion on what is meant by the words "territorial jurisdiction" or "geographical island" as provided in the said DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2011—59. In reply thereto, please be informed that the term "geographical islands" mentoned under the DILG-Memorandum Circular No. 2011-59 refers to the three (3) main islands of the Philippines, namely, Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao. Hence, if your barangay/municipality/city is located in Luzon, trainings, seminars, workshop or similar activities are strongly encouraged to be within the island of Luzon. Such being the case considering that barangay Veinte Reales, Valenzuela City is within Luzon, you are therefore allowed to conduct seminar in any place within Luzon. Along this line, may we invite your attention to the 4th paragraph of the same Memorandum Circular which provides that "Study Tour or similar activity anchored on good practices may be held outside of the geographical islands, provided that it is drawn from the list of publicly recognized good practices downloadable from but not limited to the website of the Galing Pook Foundation (www.galingpook.org), of the Local Government Academy (www.lga.gov.ph) and of this Department (www.dilg.gov.ph), and where such initiatives has a high replicability potential in the local government concerned." Based on the aforequoted provision of the said Memorandum Circular, if the activity/study tour to be conducted by your barangay is anchored on good practices and such activity is drawn from the list of publicly recognized good practices downloadable from the above-mentioned websites, such activity/study tour may be held outside of the geographical island where your barangay is located. We hope we enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, A 111 . JES B. DO UE IV Director
